SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — FINAL STAGE A TYPE, RECURRENCE,
RESPONSE, AND METHOD-GATE REPAIR

The SCI-FRUIT Conditional Feedback Core r0.2 architecture is accepted as the
basis for one bounded Stage A repair.

Do not select or recover a numerical FRUIT algorithm.

Preserve:

- SCI-FRUIT as a conditional feedback scientific core;
- no numerical recurrence, threshold, prior, inverse, filter, support rule,
  grouping, convergence threshold, iteration cap, or terminal-selection rule;
- the distinction among astronomical target, measured signal, candidate model,
  accepted model, applied model, residual, processed residual, rejoined model,
  iteration result, update contribution, and successor state;
- exact upstream producer ownership;
- FRUIT ownership of feedback composition and iteration/terminal identity;
- downstream source inference, cataloging, Pointing, OOF, and consumer fitness
  as separate operations;
- model protection as insufficient to establish model correctness, recovery of
  lost modes, true-sky identity, or unit response;
- exact PTC fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient versus frozen-component
  distinction;
- exact NOI fixed-state versus dependent-successor versus per-realization
  relearning distinction;
- representation-independent authorship and every existing nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, schemas, configuration, defaults, tests, audits,
repairs, reductions, generated products, performance records, validation,
production material, Unity material, web sources, or unlisted repository
files.

======================================================================
1. INTRODUCE A TYPE-COMPLETE FEEDBACK ALGEBRA
======================================================================

Define exact method-dependent spaces:

    Y_k = residual-removal input space;
    M_k = accepted feedback-model space;
    Z_k = iteration-result space.

Define distinct objects:

    y_k^in   in Y_k
    m_k      in M_k
    Pi_k     : M_k -> Y_k
    F_k      : Y_k -> Z_k
    B_k      : M_k -> Z_k.

For the ordinary additive remove-process-rejoin structure use:

    rho_k = y_k^in - Pi_k m_k

    z_k   = F_k(rho_k) + B_k m_k.

Bind sign convention as method identity. A method using another sign or
composition requires another identity.

Do not assume:

- Pi_k = B_k;
- B_k is an inverse of Pi_k;
- model and measured signal share a domain;
- F_k is linear;
- removal and rejoin have equal support;
- the model is true sky;
- the rejoined contribution has unit response.

When and only when F_k is an exact fixed linear operator A_k, derive:

    z_k = A_k y_k^in + D_k m_k

    D_k = B_k - A_k Pi_k.

When F_k is affine, nonlinear, thresholded, coefficient-recomputing, or
relearned, retain the complete procedure and do not silently use the linear
expansion.

======================================================================
2. BIND THE ITERATION INPUT RULE
======================================================================

Every numerical method shall state whether y_k^in is:

- the immutable original measured parent;
- the previous iteration result z_(k-1);
- a residual or product reconstructed from the immutable parent and current
  cumulative model;
- or another exactly identified product.

The word “iteration” supplies no default recurrence.

The immutable original parent remains in every lineage.

A method that returns to the immutable parent and a method that repeatedly
processes the previous result are different methods, even when they use the
same model update.

======================================================================
3. COMPLETE STATE, ITERATION, BRANCH, AND GENERATION IDENTITY
======================================================================

Use the generic convention:

    S_0 = initial seed state;

    iteration k consumes:
        S_k and y_k^in;

    iteration k produces:
        accepted/applied model m_k,
        iteration result z_k,
        successor state S_(k+1).

After completed iteration N, exact continuation begins from S_(N+1).

Identify every iteration by at least:

    lineage_id
    branch_id
    absolute zero-based iteration index
    method generation
    parent generation
    state generation.

Keep distinct:

- seed;
- continuation;
- restart;
- relearned successor;
- branch;
- retry;
- completed iteration;
- selected terminal record;
- publication.

A restart creates a new lineage and does not masquerade as continuation.

A terminal selection references an immutable completed iteration and never
mutates it.

Replace observation_resolved with application_scope_resolved or another
grouping-neutral term.

Replace universal fitted_state with exact roles such as:

    learned_candidate
    resolved_model_state
    applied_model_state
    realized_iteration_state.

Not every feedback model is fitted.

======================================================================
4. CREATE A STABLE NUMERICAL-METHOD AUTHORITY
======================================================================

Create a required method authority provisionally identified as:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1

or:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/<method-name>@<revision>.

Current state:

    unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

A complete method record shall bind:

- exact parent route and grouping;
- immutable base parent;
- iteration-input rule;
- target and model quantity;
- external versus internally learned model;
- candidate/selection/acceptance rule;
- cumulative-model versus increment meaning;
- Pi_k, F_k, B_k and their domains;
- bypass set and operator order;
- application counts;
- every fixed, recomputed, and relearned state;
- support and missing-data behavior;
- update and transition law;
- response family;
- uncertainty method;
- continuation-sufficient state;
- stochastic generator/state where applicable;
- convergence proposition;
- resource limits;
- terminal-selection rule;
- persistence/reconstruction contract;
- failure.

No numerical FRUIT route exists without one exact owner-approved method record.

The generic conditional core may be authored and later frozen while every
numerical method remains unavailable.

======================================================================
5. FACTOR STATE BY OPERATION
======================================================================

For every named residual-processing operation and every consequential state
component, record exactly one of:

    fixed numerical operator
    fixed structural state with recomputed coefficients
    externally supplied
    relearned
    bypassed
    not_applicable
    unavailable.

Do not classify an entire stage as fixed merely because one subspace or basis
is fixed.

For PTC retain explicitly:

- fixed-subspace application with recomputed application coefficients;
- frozen numerical-component subtraction;
- fully relearned PTC state.

These are different procedures with different response and uncertainty.

Bind the exact operations bypassed by the model and the exact removal and
rejoin locations. A generic “bypass” flag is insufficient.

======================================================================
6. TYPE MODEL ROLES
======================================================================

Define separately:

- astronomical target quantity;
- proposed/candidate feedback model;
- accepted model;
- applied model;
- projected removal contribution;
- model rejoin contribution;
- update contribution or diagnostic difference;
- cumulative model where applicable;
- successor model/state.

Acceptance for feedback does not establish model truth.

A method may construct or update an internal feedback model. That object has
the claim feedback_model_state only.

It is not automatically:

- a source catalog;
- a detection;
- a posterior sky;
- a deconvolved sky;
- an unbiased source estimate;
- a pointing or OOF result.

An external model and an internally learned model retain distinct parent,
prior, response, uncertainty, and generation states.

======================================================================
7. TYPE SUPPORT AND INFORMATION ORIGIN BY PATH
======================================================================

Define separately:

- measured-parent support;
- model-definition support;
- projection/removal support;
- residual-processing support;
- model-rejoin support;
- final output support;
- learning influence;
- response-query support.

For each output row or occurrence distinguish:

    residual_and_model_supported
    residual_only
    model_only
    unavailable.

A method may prohibit any of these classes.

If a method does not define unequal-support behavior, the affected output is
unavailable.

No implicit:

- zero fill;
- extrapolation;
- imputation;
- support renormalization;
- nearest-value substitution;
- model completion of missing measured support.

A model-only result is model/prior-supported, not a newly measured sky value.

Iteration, model projection, and model rejoin create no acquired exposure or
independent observation.

Path contribution, support, and influence shall be materialized or exactly
reconstructible even when intermediate numerical arrays are not retained.

======================================================================
8. DEFINE RESPONSE FAMILIES
======================================================================

For the fixed linear one-step relation define:

    R_(z<-y,k)^fixed = A_k

    R_(z<-m,k)^fixed = B_k - A_k Pi_k.

Keep these response roles distinct.

Define separately:

1. fixed one-step response;
2. one-step full-procedure response, including model/state/support changes;
3. recursive multi-iteration response;
4. selected-terminal response, including stopping and selection;
5. FRUIT-full-procedure with upstream parent held fixed;
6. whole-chain response with every included upstream data-dependent operation
   rerun.

A fixed response is not the response of a learned procedure.

If the model, coefficients, support, cleaner, stop state, or selection depends
on data, full-procedure response shall include that dependence.

Threshold crossings, branch changes, changes of support, or terminal-selection
changes may make the derivative nonexistent. Record unavailable or a typed
discontinuity/state transition rather than using the fixed-branch response.

Model bypass can reinsert a model component into a mode removed from the
measured residual path. That does not establish observational recovery of the
lost mode.

======================================================================
9. DEFINE CONDITIONAL UNCERTAINTY
======================================================================

For the exact fixed linear relation:

    z_k = A_k y_k^in + D_k m_k
    D_k = B_k - A_k Pi_k,

define the complete joint conditional covariance:

    C_z =
        A_k C_yy A_k^T
      + D_k C_mm D_k^T
      + A_k C_ym D_k^T
      + D_k C_my A_k^T.

Do not drop the cross terms without exact independence authority.

If m_k is held deterministic under the declared conditioning, state that the
reduced covariance is conditional and omits model-learning variation.

Keep separate:

- measured-parent covariance;
- model/prior covariance;
- parent-model cross covariance;
- operator/state uncertainty;
- support and threshold selection;
- stopping and terminal-selection uncertainty;
- model mismatch and bias;
- empirical repeatability;
- NOI uncertainty.

Iterations sharing one parent are not independent observations.

No uncertainty decreases as 1/sqrt(number of iterations) by implication.

A fixed-state NOI route applies the identical fixed FRUIT state and operator
graph to every compatible admitted realization.

A route that relearns model, support, cleaner, coefficients, stopping, or
terminal selection per realization is a separate NOI/FRUIT method and cannot
share the same ensemble.

The existing NOI boundary alone authorizes no numerical FRUIT uncertainty
route.

======================================================================
10. DEFINE EXACT CONTINUATION
======================================================================

An exact continuation record after iteration N shall bind every fact capable of
changing any future required result, including:

- immutable base parent;
- S_(N+1);
- accepted/cumulative model;
- learned state;
- operator state;
- support and masks;
- update and selection history;
- convergence history;
- counters and resource state;
- random generator/key/counter state where applicable;
- method and parameter versions;
- branch and generation;
- upstream and model parents.

A checkpoint is continuation-sufficient only when replay under the same future
controls yields the same scientific states and results under the declared
numerical profile.

A terminal signal array alone is not continuation state by implication.

A representation may be materialized, compact, or lineage-reconstructible,
provided the exact required state-query vocabulary is preserved.

A representation-only change does not change scientific state identity.

======================================================================
11. SEPARATE TERMINATION PROPOSITIONS
======================================================================

Keep distinct:

    iteration_completed
    resource_limit_reached
    converged
    stopped_by_policy
    failed
    selected_terminal
    consumer_fit.

Convergence shall bind:

- exact proposition;
- quantity and domain;
- metric or norm;
- scale/denominator;
- tolerance;
- direction;
- persistence or consecutive-iteration rule;
- missing/non-finite behavior;
- generation and state.

A resource maximum is not convergence.

Completion is not convergence.

Convergence is not correctness, unit response, unbiasedness, or downstream
fitness.

Terminal selection shall use one exact predeclared rule. If it inspects several
realized iterations, that selection is part of the full procedure and its
response and uncertainty.

The terminal-selection record references an immutable completed iteration.
It does not relabel or mutate it.

======================================================================
12. MAKE GROUPING METHOD IDENTITY
======================================================================

The conditional core may remain grouping-neutral.

Every numerical method shall bind exactly one:

- observation-local;
- coadd-level;
- multi-observation;
- per-array;
- joint-array;
- or another explicitly named grouping.

Do not assume:

    FRUIT(Coadd(y_o))
      =
    Coadd(FRUIT(y_o)).

Do not assume that a jointly learned model is equivalent to independent
per-observation or per-array models.

Shared parent, source model, calibration, response, or reference terms create
dependence that shall remain explicit.

Replace any universal observation-resolved lifecycle term with a
grouping-neutral application-scope term.

======================================================================
13. SEPARATE INTERNAL METHOD POLICY FROM DOWNSTREAM SCI-VAL USE
======================================================================

The FRUIT method owner owns:

- internal model selection;
- update;
- transition;
- convergence;
- stopping;
- terminal selection.

FRUIT records producer facts and local completeness.

Downstream use owners own:

- Pointing fitness;
- OOF fitness;
- source-inference admission;
- catalog admission;
- other consumer-specific use.

SCI-VAL may bind and evaluate an exact owner-approved named-use policy.
It does not author or execute FRUIT recurrence, select a model, advance an
iteration, or perform terminal selection.

A missing downstream profile does not erase an otherwise complete FRUIT
iteration or terminal product.

======================================================================
14. DEFINE ITERATION AND TERMINAL PRODUCT BUNDLES
======================================================================

Every completed iteration bundle shall contain or type unavailable:

- immutable base parent;
- exact iteration input;
- method, lineage, branch, and iteration identity;
- target and model identities;
- candidate, accepted, and applied model states;
- projected removal contribution;
- residual;
- processed residual;
- rejoin contribution;
- iteration result;
- update/successor state;
- path-specific support and influence;
- information-origin classification;
- response states;
- uncertainty states;
- validity and causes;
- continuation state;
- completion and failure state;
- provenance.

The numerical path components may be materialized or exactly reconstructible.

A terminal product is a separate immutable selection record plus the selected
iteration bundle.

Terminal FRUIT ancestry does not create a fifth generic numerical parent class
for downstream packages. A downstream consumer receives the exact underlying
MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED, detector-time, or other method-defined
product role plus complete terminal-FRUIT lineage.

======================================================================
15. USE COLLISION-FREE NOTATION
======================================================================

Do not use x or r for generic signal, residual, or model objects.

Those symbols remain reserved for paired KID readout coordinates.

Avoid bare symbols that collide with MAP, JINC, PTC, or NOI, including
unqualified Q_p, N_p, C_p, or generic sign/member symbols.

Use semantic names or package-qualified notation for:

- target;
- parent;
- iteration input;
- candidate model;
- accepted/applied model;
- residual;
- processed residual;
- rejoin contribution;
- result;
- update;
- state;
- response;
- covariance.

Return a notation crosswalk.

======================================================================
16. REQUIRED CONDITIONAL PREDICTIONS
======================================================================

Require at least:

- zero feedback model reduces to the declared residual-only route;
- identity residual processing with identical removal/rejoin map and support
  reproduces the iteration input;
- B_k = A_k Pi_k makes the fixed linear output model-independent;
- perfect model plus nonidentity rejoin does not imply true sky or unit
  response;
- model mismatch produces the declared D_k-weighted bias;
- fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient PTC differs from frozen-component
  subtraction;
- model-only support remains model/prior-supported and creates no exposure;
- support mismatch follows the declared path classes or becomes unavailable;
- fixed-state response differs from full-procedure response when model or state
  is learned;
- threshold or terminal-selection branch changes can make response unavailable;
- joint covariance requires parent-model cross terms;
- repeated iterations do not become independent measurements;
- exact continuation agrees with uninterrupted execution under the declared
  method/profile;
- restart and relearning create new lineage or generation;
- maximum iteration is not convergence;
- selected terminal identity does not mutate the selected iteration;
- observation-level FRUIT and coadd-level FRUIT do not commute by implication;
- fixed-state and per-realization-relearned NOI members cannot share an
  ensemble;
- missing FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD produces no numerical FRUIT result;
- a complete FRUIT result does not establish Pointing, OOF, source-catalog, or
  production fitness.

======================================================================
17. RESTATE THE APPROVED NARROW SEQUENCE EXCEPTION
======================================================================

Replace the opaque phrase “narrow sequence exception” with:

- one stable owner-decision ID;
- exact operator sequence;
- exact affected state;
- fixed versus recomputed versus relearned classification;
- response and uncertainty consequence;
- scope;
- failure behavior.

Do not require the Stage B author to infer the exception from a reference
fragment.

======================================================================
18. PACKET CLOSURE
======================================================================

Return the exact bytes of:

- revised Scope Brief;
- SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md;
- BOUNDARIES_AND_CONVENTIONS.md;
- the frozen PTC application excerpt;
- PROGRAM_REFERENCE.md;
- FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD required-record template;
- notation and role taxonomy;
- iteration/state/lifecycle table;
- support/information-origin table;
- response and uncertainty family table;
- required prediction list;
- Stage A semantic-change report;
- AUTHOR_INPUT_MANIFEST.md;
- manifest digest sidecar;
- compressed packet and archive sidecar.

The manifest shall bind exact role, byte count, SHA-256, authority state,
compatibility/supersession state, and author permission for every input.

No author shall be launched until Grant Wilson approves the exact packet bytes.

======================================================================
19. STAGE B DISPOSITION
======================================================================

After exact packet approval, Stage B may author the conditional SCI-FRUIT core
even while:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD = unavailable;
    numerical parent routes = unavailable;
    numerical model construction = unavailable;
    numerical stopping/selection = unavailable;
    numerical response/covariance = unavailable;
    downstream named-use profiles = unavailable.

Stage B shall derive conditional scientific consequences and typed
unavailability. It shall not fill a missing method field with familiar FRUIT
practice, current software behavior, or a plausible default.

Do not claim a numerical route, implementation conformity, response or
covariance fidelity, recovered sky modes, uncertainty coverage, convergence
adequacy, Pointing/OOF fitness, observational validation, performance,
readiness, production suitability, production authorization, or Unity
activity.
